To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

U-47,70 is a synthetic opioid with a relatively short toxic lifespan of approximately 2 years, and the data-independent acquisition of full-scan UPLC-MS data allows for retrospective data-analysis of the screening results without additional experiments on actual samples.

(1) the synthetic opioid UPLC-MS/MS screening data from the year 2014 was re-analysed retrospectively, (2) two additional U-47, 700-positive cases were found, (3) the toxic lifespan of UPLC/MS-MS in Finland was 2 years, and (4) retrospective data analysis can be used to monitor new psychoactive substances.

the retrospective data-analysis of U-47 700, the detection of U-47 in post-mortem samples and the verification of its toxic lifespan in Finland.
the toxic lifespan of the synthetic drug U-47, 700 in Finland, verified by re-analysis.
the detection of a novel psychoactive substance in forensic toxicology, its retrospective detection in stored samples and the toxic lifespan of the substance.

the toxic lifespan of the synthetic U-47,70 was approximately 2 years.

the toxic lifespan of U47,700 was approximately 2 years.

U-47, 700 has been used in Finland as a substitute for fentanyl, and that it has caused fatal overdoses.
the toxic lifespan of a substance is not necessarily long, and that the toxicological analysis of a new psychoactive substance can be a challenging endeavor for the forensic laboratory.
